title: Mood by Day-of-Week Pattern
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mood:entry
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats avg(mood_score) as avg_mood by dow
| sort - avg_mood
description: Averages your mood by day of the week, exposing the Monday dip or the Friday lift in your own rhythm.
value: A weekly mood pattern helps you plan demanding tasks for your naturally better days and protect the harder ones.
implementation: Ingest mood entries into `index=personal`; review average mood by weekday.
visualization: Bar chart of average mood by day of week.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which days of the week you tend to feel best and worst, revealing your own rhythm.
